proposed_comments.title: Complete the text-case shortcut conflict metadata
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The required correction is in AdvancedPasteSettings.GetAllHotkeyAccessors and ShortcutConflictViewModel, neither of which is part of the current upstream diff; anchoring only the new action-group declaration would leave the necessary coordinated edits outside the suggestion.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required correction is in AdvancedPasteSettings.GetAllHotkeyAccessors and ShortcutConflictViewModel, neither of which is part of the current upstream diff; anchoring only the new action-group declaration would leave the necessary coordinated edits outside the suggestion.
proposed_comments.body:
### Complete the text-case shortcut conflict metadata

**Severity:** `high`

Adding these ten leaves expands the built-in Advanced Paste hotkey list, but `AdvancedPasteSettings.GetAllHotkeyAccessors()` still has only the previous additional-action header keys and clamps later entries to `TranscodeToMp4`. `ShortcutConflictViewModel` also treats IDs above the old fixed cutoff as custom actions. Please add the ten localized header keys and derive the custom-action boundary from the actual built-in accessor count, including the optional coaching shortcut, so conflicts are labeled and routed to the correct action.

confidence.rationale: The new recursive action list directly exceeds both existing fixed-size assumptions. The converged fork corrected both sites and its final Copilot review returned zero new comments.

proposed_comments.title: Add distribution-level notice coverage for Unicode data
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The required distribution-level attribution belongs in the root NOTICE.md, which is not changed by the current upstream PR; the module-local LICENSE.txt cannot safely carry a suggestion that edits a different file.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required distribution-level attribution belongs in the root NOTICE.md, which is not changed by the current upstream PR; the module-local LICENSE.txt cannot safely carry a suggestion that edits a different file.
proposed_comments.body:
### Add distribution-level notice coverage for Unicode data

**Severity:** `medium`

This license file covers the newly vendored Unicode sentence-break data locally, but the generated lookup table is compiled into the product and the root `NOTICE.md` does not include this attribution. Please add an Advanced Paste Unicode-data entry to the root notice so distributed builds retain the required third-party notice.

confidence.rationale: The PR adds Unicode source data and a generated compiled table, while the current root NOTICE.md has no Advanced Paste or Unicode entry. The converged fork added the distribution-level notice.
